description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged jump attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Lightning], [Awoken Dragoon], [Damage Cap +20000] and [Boltstorm Spear Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Dragoon
description.text: Dragoon abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Jump attacks

description.name: Boltstorm Spear Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Boltstorm Spear after using three Dragoon abilities
